description: Prompt study: 5 GPT-5.6 Luna sessions at xhigh on svgbob, each one build node whose instructions are prompts/builder-checker.md (the loop's builder and checker prompts verbatim, Zeroshot's verifier guidance for the checker, and three sentences describing the loop), with a 6-hour time limit; otherwise luna-xhigh-svgbob-v3's task, model, resources, evaluation and pricing. Compared with luna-xhigh-svgbob-v3's check-and-repair loop at the sessions' mean cost and at their mean score (decision_rule.prompt_study).

doc_fixes.old: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: arial)
doc_fixes.new: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: Iosevka Fixed, monospace)

doc_fixes.old: - Server mode available for REST API usage
doc_fixes.new: - A separate server program (`svgbob_server`) for REST API usage

doc_fixes.old: Svgbob can also run as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.
doc_fixes.new: The separate Svgbob Server (see `crates/svgbob_server/README.md`) runs svgbob as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.

task.adjustments_rationale: Pilot v1 (luna-xhigh-svgbob-v1) showed builders overwriting or deleting the reference at ./executable (the build target) and later checkers enforcing README statements that contradict the reference. The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there); README statements that contradict the reference's behavior are corrected: default font (renders Iosevka Fixed, monospace), --inline (only -s exists), server mode (a separate svgbob_server program). The reference's own --help text is unchanged. The --scale line is ambiguous rather than false and is left as is.

decision_rule.prompt_study: Pre-registered 2026-10-09 (README, prompt study), before any run of this study. Single sessions: the 5 runs of luna-xhigh-svgbob-prompt, GPT-5.6 Luna at xhigh in one build node whose instructions are prompts/builder-checker.md, with a 6-hour node time limit; a session that reaches the limit is scored as it stands. P = their mean model cost at Luna's prices (from the Codex transcripts). Equal cost: each loop run of luna-xhigh-svgbob-v3 is compared through the workspace after its last build whose cumulative cost (builds 1..k and checks 1..k-1) does not exceed P (build 1 if build 1 alone exceeds P; the final workspace if the run ends first), and the mean hidden-test pass rate of those workspaces is compared with the mean of the 5 single sessions, each with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (runs resampled, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260924); the higher mean leads, robustly if the intervals do not overlap (bench parity --against luna-xhigh-svgbob-prompt). Equal score: the smallest budget at which the mean score of the loop runs' deliverables (each run's last build within the budget; 0 before build 1) reaches the single sessions' mean score, reported as a share of P; not reached if no budget up to the end of the loop runs reaches it (bench match --against luna-xhigh-svgbob-prompt). Runs enter as in the cost-parity study: completed, scored on all tests, no disqualifying audit finding, harness unchanged, no reference executable in the scored workspace; an attempt that ends in an infrastructure error is re-run once. No pooled test across tasks.
